end.summary:
Practised plant-eaters, meat-eaters, and animals that eat both.
Built and read simple food chains using arrows, including grass → deer and mango leaf → caterpillar.
Explained that plants make their own food using sunlight and water.
Predicted that removing food from a chain would leave fish with less food and that dead leaves break down slowly.
end.parentNote: Manav practised describing what animals eat and building food chains with arrows. They successfully read several chains and explained that plants make food using sunlight and water; they also predicted effects when part of a chain is removed. The animal-diet explanations were still being practised, with no clear mix-up recorded as corrected later. At home, ask Manav to make two short food chains using nearby plants and animals, then name what each living thing eats.
